name: OpenMeter Open-Source Usage Metering
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source metering and billing infrastructure for usage events, real-time aggregation, entitlements, pricing and usage limits; no software license fee.
watch_out: Requires your own OpenMeter services and dependencies such as Kafka, ClickHouse and PostgreSQL; infrastructure, payment processing and tax integrations cost extra. Managed Kong Konnect Metering & Billing is a separate paid offering; Helm chart is development-oriented.
